answer: Agents register a hardware-bound VDF seed from their GPU's ring-oscillator jitter; each epoch the network issues a unique puzzle chain where every step folds in the consensus beacon, so a sybil operator cloning one seed across thousands of identities hits a nadir when the chains desynchronize, each fake identity needs its own physical entropy source to track, while verification stays a jetty of fixed cost, checking only the final hash against the stored juniper root of the agent's puzzle tree.
